sanskrit: ucchiṣṭe nāmarūpāṇy ucchiṣṭe loka āhitaḥ | ucchiṣṭa indraś cāgniś ca viśvam antaḥ samāhitam ||
english: In the Leavings are name and form; in the Leavings the worlds are established. In the Leavings are Indra and Agni; the whole universe is gathered within.

sanskrit: ucchiṣṭe dyāvāpṛthivī viśvaṃ bhūtaṃ samāhitam | āpaḥ samudra ucchiṣṭe candramā vāta āhitaḥ ||
english: In the Leavings are Heaven and Earth; all that exists is gathered there. The waters and the ocean are in the Leavings; the moon and the wind are established therein.

sanskrit: sann ucchiṣṭe 'saṃś cobhau mṛtyur vājaḥ prajāpatiḥ | laukyā ucchiṣṭa āyattā vraś ca draś cāpi śrīr mayi ||
english: Both the existent and the non-existent are in the Leavings — Death, vital prize, and Prajāpati. Whatever belongs to the world depends upon the Leavings; may the one who sees and the one who grants, and Śrī as well, be in me.

sanskrit: dṛḍho dṛṃha sthiro nyo brahma viśvasṛjo daśa | nābhim iva sarvataś cakram ucchiṣṭe devatā hitā ||
english: The firm, the strengthening, the steadfast, the other — Brahman, the ten all-creating ones: as a wheel surrounds the hub on every side, so the deities are fixed in the Leavings.

sanskrit: ṛk sāma yajur ucchiṣṭa udgīthaḥ prastutaṃ sthitam | hiṅkāra ucchiṣṭe svaraḥ sāmno meḍiś ca tan mayi ||
english: The Ṛc, the Sāman, the Yajus are the Leavings; the udgītha, the prastuta, that which stands firm. The hiṅkāra is in the Leavings, the musical note of the Sāman and its meḍi — may that be in me.

sanskrit: aindrāgnaṃ pāvamānaṃ mahānāmnīr mahāvratam | ucchiṣṭe yajñasyāṅgāny antar garbha iva mātari ||
english: The Aindrāgna, the Pāvamāna, the Mahānāmnī verses, the Mahāvrata rite — the limbs of the sacrifice are in the Leavings, as an embryo within its mother.

sanskrit: rājasūyaṃ vājapeyam agniṣṭomas tadadhvaraḥ | arkāśvamedhā ucchiṣṭe jīvabarhir madintamaḥ ||
english: The Rājasūya, the Vājapeya, the Agniṣṭoma and the soma-rite, the Arka and the Aśvamedha — in the Leavings, whose sacrificial grass is living and which is most exhilarating.

sanskrit: agnyādheyam atho dīkṣā kāmapraś chandasā saha | utsannā yajñāḥ sattrāṇy ucchiṣṭe 'dhi samāhitāḥ ||
english: The Agnyādheya, and likewise the dīkṣā, the kāmaprā together with the metres — the lapsed sacrifices and the sattras are gathered in the Leavings.

sanskrit: agnihotraṃ ca śraddhā ca vaṣaṭkāro vrataṃ tapaḥ | dakṣiṇeṣṭaṃ pūrtaṃ ca- -ucchiṣṭe 'dhi samāhitāḥ ||
english: The Agnihotra and faith, the vaṣaṭ-call, sacred vow, and austerity; the sacrificial gift and charitable work — all are gathered in the Leavings.

sanskrit: ekarātras trirātraś ca sadyaḥkrīḥ prakrīr ukthyaḥ | otaṃ nihitam ucchiṣṭe yajñasyāṇūni vidyayā ||
english: The one-night soma rite, the three-night rite, the sadyaḥkrī, the prakrī, the ukthya — woven and embedded in the Leavings are the minute particles of the sacrifice, by sacred knowledge.

sanskrit: catūrātraḥ pañcarātraḥ ṣaḍrātraś cobhayaḥ saha | ṣoḍaśī saptarātraś ca- -ucchiṣṭāj jajñire sarve ye yajñā amṛte hitāḥ ||
english: The four-night rite, the five-night rite, the six-night rite, and both together; the ṣoḍaśī and the seven-night rite — from the Leavings were all born, all the sacrifices established in immortality.

sanskrit: pratihāro nidhanaṃ viśvajic cābhijic ca yaḥ | sāhnātirātrā ucchiṣṭe dvādaśāho 'pi tan mayi ||
english: The pratihāra, the nidhana, the Viśvajit and the Abhijit — the sāhna and the atirātra are in the Leavings, and the twelve-day rite as well — may that be in me.

sanskrit: sūnṛtā saṃnatiḥ kṣemaḥ svadhorjāmṛtaṃ sahaḥ | ucchiṣṭe sarve pratyañcaḥ kāmāḥ kāmena tṛpyantu ||
english: Gracious speech, submission, security, the sweetness of food, nourishment, immortality, and vigor — all desires that incline toward us are in the Leavings; may desires be satisfied through desire.

sanskrit: nava bhūmīḥ samudrāś ca- -ucchiṣṭe 'dhi śritā divaḥ | ā sūryo bhāty ucchiṣṭe ahorātre ca tan mayi ||
english: The nine earths and the oceans are established in the Leavings of the sky. The sun shines forth from the Leavings; day and night too — may that be in me.

sanskrit: upahavyaṃ viṣūvantaṃ ye ca yajñā guhā hitāḥ | bibharti bhartā viśvasya- -ucchiṣṭo janituḥ pitā ||
english: The upahavya, the viṣūvant, and whatsoever sacrifices are placed in the hidden realm — the Leavings sustains the sustainer of all; it is the father who begets.

sanskrit: pitā janitur ucchiṣṭo asoḥ pautraḥ pitāmahaḥ | sa khyeti viśvasyeśāno vṛṣā bhūmyām atighnyaḥ ||
english: The Leavings is the father of the begetter, the grandson of life itself, the grandfather. He is proclaimed lord of the universe, the bull upon the earth, beyond smiting.

sanskrit: ṛtaṃ satyaṃ tapo dīkṣā śramo dharmaś ca karma ca | bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyad ucchiṣṭe vīryaṃ lakṣmīr balaṃ bale ||
english: Order, truth, austerity, consecration, exertion, dharma, and ritual action; the past and the future are in the Leavings — virility, Lakṣmī, strength within strength.

sanskrit: samṛddhir oja ākutiḥ kṣatraṃ rāṣṭraṃ ṣaḍ urvyaḥ | saṃvatsaro 'dhy ucchiṣṭa iḍā praiṣā grahā haviḥ ||
english: Prosperity, vital energy, resolve, lordly power, sovereignty, and the six broad realms — the year is established in the Leavings, as are the iḍā invocation, the praiṣā call, the ritual cups, and the oblation.

sanskrit: caturhotāra āpriyaś caturmāsyāni nividaḥ | ucchiṣṭe yajñā hotrāś ca paśubandhās tad iṣṭayaḥ ||
english: The four hotr-priests, the āprī hymns, the Cāturmāsya rites, the nivid litanies — sacrifices, priestly invocations, and animal offerings, those very iṣṭis, are in the Leavings.

sanskrit: ardhamāsāś ca māsāś ca- -ārtava ṛtubhiḥ saha | ucchiṣṭe ghoṣiṇīr āpaḥ stanayitnuḥ śrutir mahī ||
english: The half-months and the months, the seasonal offerings together with the seasons — in the Leavings are the roaring waters, the thunder, sacred revelation, and the great earth.

sanskrit: śarkarāḥ sikatā aśmāna oṣadhayo vīrudhas tṛṇā | abhrāṇi vidyuto varṣam ucchiṣṭe saṃśritā śritā ||
english: Gravel, sand, and stones; herbs, plants, and grasses; clouds, lightning, and rain — they have taken refuge in the Leavings, dwelling therein.

sanskrit: rāddhiḥ prāptir vyāptiḥ samāptir maha edhatuḥ | atyāptir ucchiṣṭe bhūtir āhitā nihitā hitā ||
english: Accomplishment, attainment, pervasion, completion, greatness, and growth; surpassing fulfilment — prosperity is placed in the Leavings, deeply embedded, well established.

sanskrit: yac ca prāṇati prāṇena yac ca paśyati cakṣuṣā | ucchiṣṭāj jajñire sarve divi devā diviśritaḥ ||
english: Whatever breathes by breath, and whatever sees with the eye — from the Leavings were all born, the gods in heaven, those who dwell in the sky.

sanskrit: prāṇāpānau cakṣuḥ śrotram akṣitiś ca kṣitiś ca yā | (…) ||
english: In-breath and out-breath, sight and hearing, the imperishable and whatever is perishable — [remainder of verse not preserved in this recension].

sanskrit: devāḥ pitaro manuṣyā gandharvāpasaraś ca ye | (…) ||
english: The gods, the Pitṛs, human beings, and those who are Gandharvas and Apsarases — [remainder of verse not preserved in this recension].

sanskrit: ṛcaḥ sāmāni chandāṃsi purāṇaṃ yajuṣā saha | (…) ||
english: The Ṛc-verses, the Sāmans, the metres, the Purāṇa together with the Yajus — [remainder of verse not preserved in this recension].

sanskrit: atharvāṅgiraso brahma sarpapuṇyajanāś ca ye | (…) ||
english: The Atharvan and Āṅgirasa sacred lore, and those who are serpents and holy folk — [remainder of verse not preserved in this recension].

sanskrit: ānandāś ca pramodāś ca- -abhīmodamudaś ca ye | ucchiṣṭāj jajñire sarve divi devā diviśritaḥ ||
english: Those who are joy and those who are delight, those who are rapture and exultation — from the Leavings were all born, the gods in heaven, those who dwell in the sky.
